requirements.title: Milestone boundary and invariant
requirements.summary: Production safety, compliance and launch acceptance. Synthetic-only implementation; retain doctor ownership, independent secretary grants and separate patient identity/relationship/encounter; no clinical/legal/provider/commercial authority inferred.
requirements.provenance: Supplied roadmap v0.2 plus current delegated scope.

requirements.title: Controller/processor and legal-policy review
requirements.summary: Obtain current Egypt-specific professional legal/healthcare review of data responsibilities, consent and obligations. Acceptance: Obtain current qualified Egypt legal/healthcare review identifying controller/processor roles, purposes, consent basis, professional obligations and any applicable registration requirements. Record reviewer identity, date, exact product/data-flow scope, authoritative references and unresolved questions; generated prose is not legal approval. Produce approved policy requirements and owner actions for privacy, minors/caregivers, access and complaints without claiming certification. Prepare evidence for DOS-M7-GATE-LEGAL. Stop before any provider/native/live-data dependent implementation until the accountable reviewer approves the relevant decision; producing this packet does not grant approval.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M7-001 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Hosting, data-flow and transfer approval
requirements.summary: Approve providers, regions, data transfers and subprocessors before provisioning or real-patient processing. Acceptance: Inventory proposed providers, regions, data categories, subprocessors and international transfers, with verified contracts and accountable approval. Map browser/mobile/backend/storage/notifications/logging/backups and any support access; minimize payloads and separate product environments. Approve or reject the exact hosting design before provisioning or live data; no provider purchase, region assertion or production mapping is fabricated. Prepare evidence for DOS-M7-GATE-HOSTING. Stop before any provider/native/live-data dependent implementation until the accountable reviewer approves the relevant decision; producing this packet does not grant approval.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M7-002 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Clinical governance and real-patient entry gate
requirements.summary: Document accountable clinical review, prescribing limits, emergency disclaimers and permitted pilot use. Acceptance: Identify accountable clinical governance, permitted prescribing/delegation scope, change review and emergency/escalation wording for this product. Define a separately authorized pilot population, consent, supervision, stop criteria and incident response; real-patient entry requires explicit owner and qualified reviewer authorization. Keep synthetic-only default and clinical functionality restrictions until evidence is accepted; no automatic diagnosis/prescribing or clinical efficacy claim. Prepare evidence for DOS-M7-GATE-REAL-DATA. Stop before any provider/native/live-data dependent implementation until the accountable reviewer approves the relevant decision; producing this packet does not grant approval.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M7-003 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Retention, access and privacy-rights operations
requirements.summary: Implement approved record retention, access/correction/export/erasure handling with legal-hold conflicts resolved. Acceptance: Implement approved retention/access/correction/export/erasure request workflows with identity verification, scope, case history and accountable decisions. Resolve legal holds, immutable signed records and financial retention conflicts through policy; do not guess retention durations or bulk hard-delete charts. Prove scoped execution and audit of approved outcomes on synthetic data with human review of refused/partial requests.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M7-004 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Security assessment and remediation
requirements.summary: Independently assess tenancy, auth, storage, audit, mobile caches and abuse protections with tracked findings. Acceptance: Obtain independent security assessment of tenant/doctor/location boundaries, Auth/recovery, Storage/Realtime, privileged routines, APIs, audit and supported mobile caches. Track findings with reproducible synthetic evidence, severity, owner, remediation and exact-candidate retest; no self-issued security certification. No unresolved critical/high launch-blocking findings may be waived by a developer; accepted residual risks require the accountable reviewer.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M7-005 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Backup, restore and disaster recovery proof
requirements.summary: Demonstrate approved recovery objectives with scoped restore tests and protection against data loss. Acceptance: Approve recovery point/time objectives and backup custody before testing; document encrypted backup scope, retention and restore permissions. Restore a disposable synthetic backup into an isolated target and reconcile records, signed versions, documents, audit and financial entries. Record measured recovery duration and data-loss window against approved objectives, with failure recovery and no overwrite of hosted business data.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M7-006 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Observability, incident and breach response
requirements.summary: Prepare monitored failures, notification health and tested incident escalation without exposing patient payloads. Acceptance: Define redacted operational signals for authorization failures, outbox/reminder delivery, payment reconciliation, storage and recovery without patient payload logging. Prepare incident ownership, escalation, communication approval, evidence preservation and legally reviewed breach response obligations. Exercise synthetic incident detection/triage/containment/recovery and record alert delivery evidence without sending external incident messages.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M7-007 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Performance and operational readiness
requirements.summary: Verify representative load, user support, service limits, provider costs and production configuration. Acceptance: Define representative synthetic workloads and approved latency/error/resource acceptance thresholds before load testing; do not invent production capacity claims. Measure the exact candidate and document service quotas, provider cost evidence, support ownership and runbooks. Identify unsupported devices/surfaces, operational limits and rollback dependencies; no provider upgrade or production load test is implied.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M7-008 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Supervised pilot and clinical/user acceptance
requirements.summary: Run a separately authorized limited pilot, track consent and defects, and obtain independent domain approval. Acceptance: Prepare a limited supervised pilot protocol with approved population/consent, responsible clinician, support, monitoring, stop criteria and defect process. A real pilot may run only under separate explicit authorization satisfying M7 legal/hosting/real-data/security/recovery prerequisites; this task currently prepares the packet and stays blocked for live execution. Record independent clinical/user acceptance and adverse-event/defect review tied to the exact candidate, retaining unresolved issues rather than fabricating participants or results.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M7-009 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Production go/no-go and release evidence
requirements.summary: Complete exact candidate evidence and owner authorization; publication, merge and deployment remain separate actions. Acceptance: Assemble exact candidate/release scope, complete requirement evidence, independent approvals, unresolved risks, rollback/recovery and owner go/no-go record. Web-only release requires M1/M2/M3/M6/M7; doctor mobile additionally requires M4 and patient mobile additionally requires M5. Unselected/unfinished surfaces cannot be advertised as released. Keep merge, hosted migration, deployment and production activation as separate authorized actions; this task produces a reviewed release decision packet, not deployment. Prepare evidence for DOS-M7-GATE-RELEASE. Stop before any provider/native/live-data dependent implementation until the accountable reviewer approves the relevant decision; producing this packet does not grant approval.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M7-010 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

transaction_contract: Verify exact Automation target, live function/schema/trigger fingerprints, immutable project ID, route, model, retry policy, command registrations and publication scopes before writes.

Acquire parent-reviewed transaction serialization lock and reread every scoped ID; existing equal payload is a no-op only after full canonical comparison; any differing state/history aborts. Never overwrite existing tasks, decisions, execution or requirement history.
Create or verify the real OPEN milestone start decision before any task; create every task through supported function and link every task to that decision with blocking=true in the SAME transaction.
Create all requirement, decision and dependency links and refresh contracts after final metadata. Do not commit partial task/link batches.

Assert exact payload counts, complete links, zero ready Doctor tasks using live ready-task predicate, zero claims/runs/executions, no publication authority, and all start decisions still OPEN immediately before commit.
Dry-run rollback and review returned evidence first. Parent controls any commit; never remove a guard from the original draft SQL.
After commit read back canonical packets and zero-ready evidence. Keep all nine start gates open until parent confirms all nine safely saved; release each milestone separately in dependency order.
